name: What types of bathroom sinks are available for installation?

mainEntity.name: What types of bathroom sinks are available for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several common types of bathroom sinks, each with distinct installation requirements and aesthetic appeals. Undermount sinks are installed beneath the counter, creating a seamless look and easy cleaning. Drop-in (or self-rimming) sinks sit on top of the counter with a visible rim. Vessel sinks are freestanding bowls that sit entirely on the countertop. Wall-mounted sinks attach directly to the wall, saving floor space. Pedestal sinks feature a basin supported by a standalone pedestal. The best choice depends on your bathroom's style, available space, and functional needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common types include undermount, drop-in, vessel, wall-mounted, and pedestal sinks. Each offers different aesthetics and installation methods.
